Dr. Sarah Chen

Principal Investigator

Return to archive↗

This is an inherited source-site record. Membership, biography, affiliations, and publication details have not been confirmed as BIOracle information.

Biography as supplied.

Dr. Chen leads the Evolutionary Processes Lab with a focus on phylogenetic methods and molecular evolution. Her work has pioneered new approaches to understanding deep evolutionary relationships through genomic data. With over 15 years of experience, she has published extensively on RNA evolution and computational phylogenetics.

Areas of expertise

Phylogenetics · Molecular Evolution · Computational Biology

Education as supplied

  • PhD in Evolutionary Biology, Stanford University
  • MS in Computational Biology, MIT
  • BS in Biology, UC Berkeley

Research interests

  • Phylogenetic inference methods
  • RNA structure evolution
  • Ancient DNA analysis
  • Molecular clock modeling

Publication records as supplied

  • Chen, S. et al. (2023). Novel approaches to deep-time phylogenetic reconstruction. Nature Methods.
  • Chen, S. & Rodriguez, M. (2022). RNA structure constraints in viral evolution. Molecular Biology and Evolution.
  • Chen, S. et al. (2021). Computational methods for ancient DNA analysis. Genome Research.
